englishOnly: This tool works on English text. It reads an English job description and an English CV, and it writes the summaries in English.
jobPlaceholder: Paste the full text of the job posting here…
statusMatching: Matching your CV to the posting
statusNeedInput: Add the job description and your CV to start.
statusPrivate: Your CV is read in this tab. Nothing is stored.
resultHeading: {count, plural, one {# summary for} other {# summaries for}} <role>{title}</role>
fromPosting: The title comes from the posting. Every skill appears in both your CV and the posting, and every result is a line from your CV.
fromResume: We could not find a job title in the posting, so this uses the title in your CV. Every skill appears in both documents.
titleGuess: The title is a best guess from the wording. Edit it if it is wrong.
noResult: Your CV has no line with a number in it, so each summary marks where your result goes.

hints.formula: Title and level, then domain and years, then one result. Works for almost any CV.
hints.resultFirst: Opens on your strongest number. Good when the result is more impressive than the title.
hints.short: Two lines for a one page CV, when space at the top is tight.
hints.shortSecond: Two lines for a one page CV. Uses a second result from your CV so it does not repeat the first.

toastFailed: Copy failed. Select the summary and copy it yourself.
claims: Claims {list}. Keep only what your CV can evidence.
slot: Replace the bracket with a real number before you use it.
noTitleHeading: We could not find a job title
noTitleBody: Neither document names a role we recognise, so a summary would be a guess. Paste the full posting, including the title at the top, or add your current job title to your CV, then try again.
noMatch: Your CV and this posting share almost no vocabulary. Fix that before the summary. Start with the <link>ATS resume checker</link>.
missingHeading: In the posting, not in your CV
missingBody: None of these can go in your summary yet. Add the ones you can honestly evidence to a bullet first, then run it again.
ctaTitle: Summary done. Is the rest of the CV?
ctaBody: Sign up free and FitMyCV rewrites your whole CV and cover letter against this posting, keeping your real experience.
ctaButton: Tailor my whole CV to this job
examplesBody: Yours will be built from the posting you paste and the results your CV already shows. Here is the shape they take.
